description: Implementation of a rate limiting service for transport layer in Thingsboard, managing limits per tenant, device, gateway, and IP address, including profile updates and IP-based access control.

classes.name: DefaultTransportRateLimitService
classes.description: Service implementing transport rate limiting, managing limits per tenant, device, gateway, and IP, with profile updates and IP access control.

methods.name: checkLimits
methods.description: Checks if the tenant, device, and gateway limits are exceeded based on incoming data points and connection type.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates rate limits based on tenant profile updates or specific tenant ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes rate limit data for a tenant or device.

methods.name: checkAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is allowed based on IP rate limiting rules.

methods.name: onAuthSuccess
methods.description: Resets failure count and unblocks IP on successful authentication.

methods.name: onAuthFailure
methods.description: Increments failure count and blocks IP if failure threshold is exceeded.

methods.name: invalidateRateLimitsIpTable
methods.description: Removes inactive or blocked IPs from the IP rate limit table based on inactivity timeout.
